answer: The beacon test I would run is Forklift operator licence with employer training log: a licence plus an employer log of supervised hours, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The verifier never sees the raw secret, only a proof that a licence plus an employer log of supervised hours — so privacy survives, and the island is that a stolen database buys the attacker nothing at all. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the copper of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
